lines.speaker: Breeze
lines.text: Stay close, my dear. I've Soothed this crowd twice over already and they're still ready to bolt at a raised voice.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Where's Kelsier? He said he'd be here.

lines.speaker: Breeze
lines.text: He said a great many things this morning, none of which I liked. Dockson has the rest of the crew at the alley mouth. We watch, we learn who they've taken, and we leave. Nothing heroic.

lines.speaker: Breeze
lines.text: Mind the Inquisitor on the south side. And the guards in the lanes. Don't Push anything you can't afford to be seen Pushing.
